node.operational-asset.title: Operational asset
node.operational-asset.description: An asset in the governed operational architecture.

node.observation.title: Observation
node.observation.description: A time-bound observation about an operational subject.

node.control.title: Control
node.control.description: A governed security or assurance control.

node.control-link.title: Control link
node.control-link.description: The declared legacy node vocabulary for a reified control link; retained only until its removal is shipped.

node.control-test.title: Control test
node.control-test.description: An execution that evaluates a control.

node.verification-result.title: Verification result
node.verification-result.description: A recorded verification outcome for a requirement.

node.finding.title: Finding
node.finding.description: A finding requiring analysis or remediation.

node.audit-link.title: Audit link
node.audit-link.description: The declared legacy node vocabulary for a reified audit link; retained only until its removal is shipped.

node.risk-control-mapping.title: Risk-control mapping
node.risk-control-mapping.description: A structural mapping between risk context and a control implementation.

node.scoped-control-implementation.title: Scoped control implementation
node.scoped-control-implementation.description: A control implementation scoped to operational context.

node.document.title: Document
node.document.description: A governed document in the architecture graph.

node.research-artifact.title: Research artifact
node.research-artifact.description: A manifest entry for a research-stage artifact.

node.research-provenance.title: Research provenance node
node.research-provenance.description: A provenance-bearing research input, intermediate, claim, or prose locator.

edge.associated.title: Associated
edge.associated.description: Relates a subject to another participant without asserting a narrower semantic.

edge.depends-on.title: Depends on
edge.depends-on.description: States that the source depends on the target.

edge.evidenced-by.title: Evidenced by
edge.evidenced-by.description: Connects a governed subject to supporting evidence.

edge.observed-in.title: Observed in
edge.observed-in.description: Connects a governed subject to an observation in which it appears.

edge.affects.title: Affects
edge.affects.description: States that the source affects the target.

edge.mitigated-by.title: Mitigated by
edge.mitigated-by.description: Connects a risk-bearing source to the target that mitigates it.

edge.exploits.title: Exploits
edge.exploits.description: States that the source exploits the target.

edge.assessed-in.title: Assessed in
edge.assessed-in.description: Connects a subject to the assessment or audit in which it is assessed.

edge.governed-by.title: Governed by
edge.governed-by.description: Connects a subject to its governing authority or artifact.

edge.implements-requirement.title: Implements requirement
edge.implements-requirement.description: States that an asset or control implements a requirement.

edge.mitigates.title: Mitigates
edge.mitigates.description: States that the source mitigates the target.

edge.requirement-parent.title: Parent requirement
edge.requirement-parent.description: Connects a requirement to its parent requirement.

edge.requirement-refines.title: Refines
edge.requirement-refines.description: Connects a refining requirement to the requirement it refines.

edge.requirement-supersedes.title: Supersedes
edge.requirement-supersedes.description: Connects a replacement requirement to the requirement it supersedes.

edge.requirement-related.title: Related requirement
edge.requirement-related.description: Records a symmetric relationship between requirements.

edge.traceability-implements.title: Traceability implements
edge.traceability-implements.description: Connects a requirement to an artifact that implements it.

edge.traceability-tests.title: Traceability tests
edge.traceability-tests.description: Connects a requirement to an artifact that tests it.

edge.traceability-documents.title: Traceability documents
edge.traceability-documents.description: Connects a requirement to an artifact that documents it.

edge.traceability-constrains.title: Traceability constrains
edge.traceability-constrains.description: Connects a requirement to an artifact it constrains.

edge.traceability-verifies.title: Traceability verifies
edge.traceability-verifies.description: Connects a requirement to an artifact that verifies it.

edge.contains.title: Contains
edge.contains.description: States that the source architecture participant contains the target.

edge.trust-boundary.title: Trust boundary
edge.trust-boundary.description: Records a trust-boundary relation between architecture participants.

edge.asset-supports.title: Asset supports
edge.asset-supports.description: States that one operational asset supports another architecture participant.

edge.accesses.title: Accesses
edge.accesses.description: States that the source architecture participant accesses the target.

edge.data-flow.title: Data flow
edge.data-flow.description: Records directed data flow from source to target.

edge.subject-of.title: Subject of
edge.subject-of.description: Connects an asset to an analysis or governance artifact for which it is the subject.

edge.protects.title: Protects
edge.protects.description: States that a control protects the target.

edge.maps-to.title: Maps to
edge.maps-to.description: Connects a control to another governed control or framework concept.

edge.caused-by.title: Caused by
edge.caused-by.description: Connects a finding to its cause.

edge.remediated-by.title: Remediated by
edge.remediated-by.description: Connects a finding to its remediation.

edge.registered-in.title: Registered in
edge.registered-in.description: Connects a risk scenario to the register containing it.

edge.documented-in.title: Documented in
edge.documented-in.description: Connects a threat-model entry to its documenting artifact.

edge.audit-scopes.title: Audit scopes
edge.audit-scopes.description: Connects an audit to a subject in its scope.

edge.audit-assesses.title: Audit assesses
edge.audit-assesses.description: Connects an audit to a subject it assesses.

edge.audit-follows-up.title: Audit follows up on
edge.audit-follows-up.description: Connects an audit to a prior matter it follows up.

edge.observed-on.title: Observed on
edge.observed-on.description: Connects an observation to the operational asset observed.

edge.has-source.title: Has source
edge.has-source.description: Connects an evidence artifact to the source from which it was derived.

edge.superseded-by.title: Superseded by
edge.superseded-by.description: Connects an older evidence artifact to its replacement.

edge.of-control.title: Of control
edge.of-control.description: Connects a control test to the control it evaluates.

edge.verifies-requirement.title: Verifies requirement
edge.verifies-requirement.description: Connects a verification result to the requirement it verifies.

edge.maps-control.title: Maps control
edge.maps-control.description: Connects a risk-control mapping node to its direct control.

edge.maps-scoped-implementation.title: Maps scoped implementation
edge.maps-scoped-implementation.description: Connects a risk-control mapping node to its scoped implementation.

edge.maps-risk-scenario.title: Maps risk scenario
edge.maps-risk-scenario.description: Connects a risk-control mapping node to its risk scenario.

edge.maps-threat-model.title: Maps threat model
edge.maps-threat-model.description: Connects a risk-control mapping node to its threat model.

edge.in-asset-context.title: In asset context
edge.in-asset-context.description: Connects a risk-control mapping node to its operational asset context.

edge.has-observation.title: Has observation
edge.has-observation.description: Connects a risk-control mapping node to a supporting observation.

edge.scoped-implementation-of.title: Scoped implementation of
edge.scoped-implementation-of.description: Connects a scoped control implementation to its control.

edge.scoped-to-asset.title: Scoped to asset
edge.scoped-to-asset.description: Connects a scoped control implementation to its operational asset.

edge.has-research-artifact.title: Has research artifact
edge.has-research-artifact.description: Connects a research run to an artifact in its manifest.

edge.artifact-has-provenance.title: Artifact has provenance
edge.artifact-has-provenance.description: Connects a research artifact to a provenance node.

edge.provenance-derived-from.title: Derived from
edge.provenance-derived-from.description: States that the downstream provenance node was derived from the upstream node.

edge.provenance-supports.title: Provenance supports
edge.provenance-supports.description: States that upstream evidence supports a downstream research claim.

edge.provenance-selected.title: Selected
edge.provenance-selected.description: States that an upstream candidate or source was selected for a downstream step.

edge.provenance-cited.title: Cited
edge.provenance-cited.description: States that downstream prose or a claim cites the upstream source.

edge.provenance-contributed-to.title: Contributed to
edge.provenance-contributed-to.description: States that an upstream provenance node contributed to a downstream node.
